headline: Ludhiana Fire Detections Rise as PM2.5 Forecast Nears 81.9 µg/m3
briefing: On 2025-10-31, satellite monitoring recorded 11 fire detections in Ludhiana district, with a total fire radiative power of 41.2 MW. The district ranked 8 in Punjab, where the total reached 273 detections. Winds blew from the northwest at 6.1 km/h, with upwind fire pressure coming primarily from Outside Punjab at 61.0% and Tarn Taran at 17.5%. For the next day, the PM2.5 forecast for Ludhiana city centres around a p50 value of 81.9 µg/m3, with an 80% uncertainty band ranging from a p10 of 53.6 to a p90 of 102.5 µg/m3. Today's value stood at 81.5 µg/m3. Satellite fire detections represent a lower bound due to missed fires, cloud cover, and overpass timing limitations [K101].

# Ludhiana: fire detections, season 2024

In the 2024 season (Sep 15 to Nov 30), satellite fire detection (VIIRS S-NPP) recorded 339 fire detections in Ludhiana district, with a total fire radiative power of 1,428 MW. Among the 22 districts it ranked number 12 by detections.

The busiest day was 2024-11-18, with 51 detections.

Compared with the previous season: -78% compared with 2023 (1,512 detections).
